about: The 3D parts library's queue (docs/art/TRIPO_LEDGER.md): each item's reference image is made from its category's template with its subject; references go to ~/Everloom-Tripo/refs, never the repo.

templates.hair: Anime style 3D character asset reference. A single hairstyle only, worn on an invisible head: no face, no head, no skin, no body visible, just the hair itself floating in its worn shape. {subject}. Neutral light grey hair colour, smooth clean strands. Three-quarter front view, centered, the whole hairstyle in frame with margin around it. Clean cel-shaded anime rendering, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no shadows, no text, no watermark.
templates.clothing: Anime style 3D clothing asset reference. A single {subject}, shown as a ghost-mannequin product shot: the garment holds its worn 3D shape on an invisible body; no person, no skin, no head, no hands, no mannequin, no hanger visible. Front view, centered, the whole garment in frame with margin around it. Simple clean shapes, solid plain colours, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no shadows, no text, no logo, no watermark.
templates.footwear: Anime style 3D clothing asset reference. A single {subject}, one shoe only, standing on its own as if worn by an invisible foot: no foot, no leg, no skin visible. Three-quarter front view, centered, the whole shoe in frame with margin around it. Simple clean shapes, solid plain colours, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no shadows, no text, no logo, no watermark.
templates.accessory: Anime style 3D accessory asset reference. A single {subject}, isolated on its own, no person, no head, no hands, no mannequin visible. Simple clean shapes, solid plain colours, clean cel-shaded anime rendering, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no shadows, no text, no logo, no watermark.
templates.fantasy: Anime style 3D character asset reference. {subject}, shown on its own in its worn shape as if on an invisible character: no head, no face, no skin, no body visible. templates.product: Catalogue product photo for a 3D asset: {subject}, isolated on a plain white background, centered, the whole item in frame with margin around it, three-quarter view, soft even studio lighting, no shadows, simple clean anime-style shapes and solid plain colours, nothing else in the picture, no text, no logo, no watermark.
